participants.necessity_rationale: Owns the bounded launcher and capability-adopt CLI implementation plan across the two authored script surfaces.
Owns adversarial regression design for compatibility receipt ordering, mode refusals, project-only roles, and verifier write-freedom.
Owns the mandatory same-rollout docs/v2 reconciliation and portable public wording for resolver-mode and verifier behavior.
Provides the required cross-family G-plan review of the repair contract before any source edit.

obligations.text: Plan the smallest resolver-mode-aware change that retains project definition-ref identity while producing a real pre-assignment compatibility receipt only where the ladder permits it.
Plan a read-only window verify CLI over the production substantive-observation verifier with explicit exit semantics and no project mutation.
Specify positive and negative tests for resolved refs, permitted and forbidden modes, project-only roles, invalid observations, and verifier write-freedom.
Specify mirror, digest, compiled-worker, generated-host, package-integrity, focused, and full-suite verification before landing.
Reconcile docs/v2 to exact shipped resolver and verifier behavior in the same rollout.
Adversarially review the executable repair plan and exact source boundaries before approval.

excluded_roles.why_unnecessary: The repair restores the already-ratified resolver ladder and adds no architecture decision or new contract schema.
The new verb is an internal capability-adopt script action, not a user-facing /guild command definition.
No authored hook behavior changes; compiled workers are regenerated from changed script sources and verified by the eval lane.
Fail-closed privacy and write-freedom are explicit eval and cross-host review obligations; no offensive or new trust-boundary design is introduced.
The defect is reproduced in current source and needs no external research.
